verdict.rationale: Cognee has first-party documented .remember/.recall operations explicitly designed for storing and retrieving conversational memory, with session-based short-term caching plus permanent graph memory, and recall() automatically selecting semantic retrieval strategies — directly matching the story of persisting and retrieving conversation context via semantic search. Community evidence corroborates the underlying architecture (graph+vector+relational, benchmark accuracy claims) though also notes the setup can feel 'heavy' for some use cases. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of retrieval quality/session persistence across sessions and no evidence addressing edge cases like retrieval accuracy degradation over long-running sessions.
